skill.summary: Customer feedback digest — collect, categorize, and summarize reviews, survey responses, and support tickets. Weekly cron or on-demand.

latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of doctorclaw-feedback-digest.
- Collects, categorizes, and summarizes customer reviews, survey responses, and support tickets.
- Provides sentiment and topic analysis, urgent issue flagging, and trend summaries.
- Generates weekly or on-demand feedback digests with response suggestions for negative reviews.
- Flexible source integration and delivery options, plus setup and customization guidance.
